P4 south-east bedroom (parts/room-38.mjs) is furnished: one red bed with its head on the back wall at x76, a barrel dresser with a potted poppy, a fence-post table with a standing lantern, and a chest. The door cell and the z19 lane stay clear.
make.sh produced a whole build.nbt; the part's line reads "8 placed" with no REFUSED or OFF-PALETTE writes. The render shows a readable bedroom.
The walk verdict is not yet OK because the shell's walls and door are not in this copy; the lantern gives the room light 11-12 at the feet.
left: The room tool's walk check says UNREACHABLE (no way in): this copy has no shell walls or door, so the room is open to the outside. Re-run `$MCD room` after the shell and fittings merge; the lane is z19 x73..75 from the door cell (73,19) to the bed foot (76,19).

FIT 'bed against an opening' at (76,6,20): the back wall z21 at x76 is absent in this copy. The plan makes z21 solid at x76 (windows are at x74..75, back door at x72), so this should clear after the shell merges.
`$MCD check` lists my barrel, table slab, chest and bed as FLOATING: the upper floor layer y5 under them is the shell's and is air in this copy. Expected to clear after the merge.

Floor level conflict: `mcd plan` says the floor is y=6 (feet at y6, per plan.md and rooms.json), but `mcd room` reports floor y=7 and reads its light grid at y7. I placed the furniture at feet level y6 per plan.md. The tool or the plan needs a fix before the room check can say OK.
This is a one-bed room, which the spec allows (one or two beds); the second bed did not fit the 4 x 2 floor with a clear lane.

elements.md house-level items (beds per house, kitchen, parlour) are not ticked: they are for the house as a whole, and this room only supplies one bed. plan.md's checklist is for the architect's parts, so I left it alone.

waste.what: I placed each furniture cell by hand across three layers() calls (one per y level), then worked out the bed's head and foot cells and the lantern cell by hand.
waste.cost: 3 layers() calls and 1 bed() call plus about 4 coordinate checks, with no retries
waste.tool: A room-furnish helper that takes a 3D legend per room (y levels as separate grids) and a bed spec, e.g. `layers()` accepting a stack of layers with origin y, or a `furnishRoom(g, room, spec)` that reads the box from rooms.json.

waste.what: I checked the room's walk verdict and light by hand, from reading two tool outputs that disagree on the floor level (plan y=6, room y=7).
waste.cost: 3 extra runs of the room command and a `plan` read to settle the floor level
waste.tool: `mcd room` should print the floor level it uses and agree with `mcd plan`; one shared value would save the cross-check.

waste.what: The walk and FIT checks cannot pass in a part-only copy because they need the shell's walls and door.
waste.cost: The walk verdict and the bed FIT item stay unverified until the parts merge
waste.tool: A `mcd room --assume-shell` mode or a stub shell in a part's test build, so each room can be walk-checked before the merge.

companions.task: Lay and verify the upper-floor layer at y5 under the room (the floor the barrel, table, chest and bed stand on) and the back and east walls, so the floating and bed-against-opening items clear before the merge.
Check the single standing lantern on the table against the light map after the merge, to confirm the back corners by the window stay at 8 or more with the shell in place.
